sections.heading: PRT Updateoperator
sections.content: The PRT Update operator allows you to update particle properties based on matching particles within a PRTLoader object.

sections.heading: PRT Update
sections.content: PRT object: the PRTLoader object whose particles will be referenced.

sections.heading: Input Channels
sections.content:
Channels: controls which particle data channels to copy from the input PRTLoader object’s particles.

Update as custom floats/vectors: unrecognized channels (channels with names that don’t match any of the channels in the default channels list) will be updated as custom particle properties (floats/vectors, depending on data type).

sections.heading: Settings
sections.content:
Flip rotation: flips the w-component of quaternions loaded from PRT data.Delete if not found: if a particle does not have a matching particle in the input PRTLoader object, it will be deleted.
